entries.title: User profile
entries.body: Kayla. QA at Tebra/NHHA. Based in Bentonville, AR. AUDHD/PDA-aware support style. Married, post-wedding. Prefers ambient, low-demand surfaces.

entries.title: Writing preferences
entries.body: Plain language. Dated entries. No exclamation points. Short paragraphs. Lists over prose when items are parallel. Markdown headers under six words.

entries.title: Default bug investigation protocol
entries.body: Reproduce locally, capture seed data, check Sentry for prior occurrences, diff against last known good build, file findings in TTOAD with reproduction steps before commenting on the PR.

entries.title: Route to low-demand narrator on bad-brain days
entries.body: When the day is flagged low-energy or bad-brain, prefer narrators with comic or warm tone over critical or analytic tones. Never reframe medical or health entries comically.

entries.title: GitHub is the source of truth
entries.body: When backpack and a repo disagree about state, the repo wins. Update Backpack in place to match.

entries.title: Memory ecology terms
entries.body: Backpack = active carry-state. Doctrine = stable truths. Hoard = deep archive. Renderers = surfaces that read from these three layers.

entries.title: Team roster
entries.body: Jamie — eng lead, NHHA. Ishan — eng lead, RCM (he/him). Reorg-on-call — rotating weekly. Update in place when roles change; do not append.

entries.title: Jira boards in active use
entries.body: TTOAD = primary QA board (post-migration key). NHHA-RCM = release tracking. Old keys (SQDTOAD, etc.) preserved for historical search; do not file new tickets there.
